PHASE 10 detail 7: each task, run deterministic-only and deterministic+LLM over the same
assertions. `b` counts assertions only the LLM path passed, `c` those only the
deterministic path passed — **false repairs**. McNemar's χ² is used when `b + c ≥ 25` and the exact binomial below it. A task is enabled-by-opt-in
for a language only when it is non-inferior there (one-sided α = 0.05, margin 0.02) and its false-repair rate `c / n` is at most 0.01 in every category.

**No evaluation has run.** No model was reachable where Phase 10 was built (huggingface.co refused), so there are no paired outcomes, no McNemar table and no false-repair rate. Every task stays behind `--ai-all-tasks`: the language maps in `thresholds.toml` are empty.
